views.title: Estate and surroundings
views.description: Main house, Peristyl and Dependance in the terrain of the Lohn estate above Kehrsatz.

views.title: Main house and Dependance
views.description: The two buildings linked by the glazed Peristyl.

views.title: Ground floor rooms
views.description: Dollhouse view of the ground floor: Halle, Salon, Fumoir, Kleines Esszimmer and the Speisesaal in the Dependance.

views.title: Upper floor rooms
views.description: Dollhouse view of the 1. OG: guest rooms around the Obere Halle.

views.title: Ground floor plan
views.description: Plan view of the ground floor.

pointsOfInterest.title: West portico
pointsOfInterest.description: Entrance front with four giant sandstone piers, the upper loggia balustrade and the segmental pediment.

pointsOfInterest.title: Garden front
pointsOfInterest.description: South facade with the central pediment and the terrace in front of the Grosser Salon.

pointsOfInterest.title: Peristyl
pointsOfInterest.description: The glazed passage of 1959/60 between the main house and the Dependance.

pointsOfInterest.title: Grosser Salon
pointsOfInterest.description: The principal reception room behind the garden front, with its round faience stove.

pointsOfInterest.title: Speisesaal
pointsOfInterest.description: The dining hall in the former stables of the Dependance.

pointsOfInterest.title: Stair hall
pointsOfInterest.description: Open-well stone stair behind the Tuscan columns of the Halle.

pointsOfInterest.title: Rauchzimmer
pointsOfInterest.description: The smoking room (Fumoir) with its Louis XV seat furniture in pink damask, as furnished in 2019.

pointsOfInterest.title: Kleines Esszimmer
pointsOfInterest.description: Small dining room with a turquoise faience stove and a built-in china vitrine.

pointsOfInterest.title: Churchill-Zimmer
pointsOfInterest.description: The large guest room in the north-east corner (Churchill stayed at Lohn in 1946).

properties.label: Measured
properties.value: Hipped roof with a flatter eave kick; upper planes about 38 deg, eave planes about 26 deg
properties.source: Planes fitted to the swissSURFACE3D 2023 point cloud; median deviation of the model roof from the points below 0.02 m, 88 % of points within 0.15 m.

properties.label: Covering
properties.source: Roof colour from the 2024 orthophoto; tile type not documented.

properties.label: Shape
properties.value: Segmental pediment over the west portico; cartouche not modelled
properties.source: 2019 tour (Vorplatz panorama) and LiDAR apex 575.65 m a.s.l.

properties.label: Geometry
properties.value: Open-well stone stair, 28 risers EG to 1. OG (0.146 m), two quarter landings, rounded stone string
properties.source: Tread lines of the 1. OG plan (2005); storey height 4.09 m measured from the stair panorama (node12); string, handrail and open upper flight from tour node2 and node12.

properties.label: Room
properties.value: Former stables, now the dining hall; oak parquet, net area 67.3 m2 modelled vs 67.95 m2 on the plan
properties.source: Plan 2005 room outline and label; floor finish from the 2019 tour.

properties.label: Source
properties.value: Kachelofen in the Churchill-Zimmer; outline from the floor plan, height and colour from the 2019 tour
properties.source: Plan 2005 fixture outline; panorama of the Grosses Schlafzimmer.

properties.label: Source
properties.value: Painted cupboard wall with a bow-fronted glazed vitrine over the whole west wall
properties.source: 2019 tour (Kleines Esszimmer panorama): front and bow read from the floor contacts, heights from the arched head and the crown.

properties.label: Detail
properties.value: Porcelain behind the glass is not modelled; the red-lined interior is shown as one colour

properties.label: Correction
properties.value: White double door between Vorsaal and Speisesaal (an open arch up to v005)
properties.source: 2019 tour (Speisesaal panoramas): leaves seen closed and folded back; leaf top 2.36 m above the floor (LL-D031).

properties.label: Furnishing
properties.value: Interior as photographed in the 2019 tour; pictures are frames with a neutral canvas, carpets show dominant colours only
properties.source: Interior pass v006 (LL-D030): positions read from the panoramas and set against the walls.

properties.label: Geometry
properties.value: Six posts per side at 2.31 m centres; gable roof 19 deg
